home.title: Consultation Reservation Platform
home.body: A GnuConsultation Area7 user template for education centers and academies that need consultation landing, reservable programs, availability guidance, member accounts, and reservation history.

identity.title: What this template is
identity.body: Academy Core Template keeps the active glitter-academy_core template identity while shaping it for education and consultation service operations.

auth.title: Authentication flow support
auth.body: Login, registration, password recovery, reset links, profile, and password change pages are included at template level.

form.title: Stable form structure
form.body: Main authentication forms use one form state with dataKey form so visible fields and submitted payloads stay aligned.

cms_ready.title: CMS and API readiness
cms_ready.body: The structure is prepared for consultation area notices, page content, program data, and module-backed operational APIs.

extensible.title: Extensible structure
extensible.body: Instructor, program, timetable, notice, FAQ, contact, and consultation pages are separated so site operators can replace static sections with CMS or module data.

modules.title: Required and optional modules
modules.body: Consultation Area and Page modules are expected. Glitter Reservation and consultation modules are optional and degrade gracefully when unavailable.

beta.title: Current beta status
beta.body: This template is a beta education-site example. Production operators should review content, permissions, notifications, mail delivery, and booking policies before launch.

course.title: Education institute homepage
course.body: Introduce core courses, admission flows, and operating policies with template-managed content.

operation.title: Program operation site
operation.body: Use program, timetable, notice, and FAQ pages as the baseline for recurring education operations.

mvp.title: Authentication-based MVP
mvp.body: Use account pages and mypage flows as a starting point for beta services that need member access.

identity.title: Reservation platform identity
identity.body: Academy Core now centers the glitter-academy_core template around consultation reservation journeys while preserving the existing GnuConsultation Area7 template structure.

landing.title: Start with email verification and choose an available consultation slot.
landing.body: The page connects to Glitter Reservation services, slot availability, email verification, booking creation, lookup, and cancellation APIs when the module is installed.

login_required.title: Member access supported
login_required.body: Visitors can start the public reservation flow, and signed-in members can review reservation history from mypage.

module.unavailable_body: Live reservation features require the Glitter Reservation module. This page remains available and shows fallback guidance until the module routes are installed and services are published.

services.title: Reservable consultation programs
services.body: Published services from the reservation module appear here as bookable academy consultations.
services.empty: No public reservation services are open yet.

availability.title: Availability and schedule guidance
availability.body: Select a service and date from the consultation page to load live slots. Operators control schedules, holidays, breaks, and slot rules inside the reservation module.

form.verification_body: The reservation module requires a verified email before booking submission.
form.booking_body: Choose a service, date, time slot, and contact information before submitting.
form.verified_notice: Email verification is complete. Continue with reservation details.
form.verification_sent: A verification link has been sent to your email address.
form.verification_failed: Verification email could not be sent.
form.verification_refresh_failed: Verification status could not be refreshed.
form.no_slots: No consultation slots are open for the selected date.
form.slot_failed: Available time slots could not be loaded.
form.name: Student or Guardian Name
form.email_readonly: Verified email is submitted with the reservation.
form.memo_placeholder: Share learning concerns, target subject, and scheduling notes.
form.failed: Consultation reservation could not be submitted.

operation.title: Operation checklist
operation.body: Before launch, seed public services, define schedules and holidays, verify mail delivery, review cancellation policy, and confirm staff notification routing.
operation.scope_body: The template includes reservation-facing pages and module API bindings. Full CRM, payment, attendance, LMS, and staff workflow customization remain outside template scope.
operation.beta_body: This is a beta reservation platform template. Confirm module data, validation messages, email verification, and cancellation policy before production use.

scope.question: What is included?
scope.answer: Public pages, authentication pages, mypage profile/password pages, and a consultation fallback page are included.

modules.question: What is excluded?
modules.answer: Full academy ERP, payment, attendance, LMS, and custom consultation workflow logic are outside the template scope.

consultation.unavailable_body: Consultation booking is ready to connect to Glitter Reservation. Enable the module and seed public services to show live booking options.
consultation.service_body_fallback: This service is available for consultation booking.

about.title: About Academy Core
about.subtitle: A focused GnuConsultation Area7 user template for education institutes, academies, program sites, and consultation-based services.

programs.title: Programs
programs.subtitle: Organize courses, tracks, cohorts, and beta service offers with a structure ready for CMS or API integration.

instructors.title: Instructors
instructors.subtitle: Use this page as an instructor profile directory or connect it to a module-backed staff API.

timetable.title: Timetable
timetable.subtitle: Publish class schedules, consultation slots, operational periods, and intake calendars.

notices.title: Notices
notices.subtitle: Connect this page to the consultation area module for announcements, admissions updates, and operation notices.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Explain the included template scope, optional modules, and launch checklist for operators.

contact.title: Contact
contact.subtitle: Provide institute contact details or route visitors into consultation booking.

consultation.title: Consultation
consultation.subtitle: Connect reservation services or a custom consultation module when the operational flow is ready.
